name: verify-correct
description: Check that a generated answer is grounded in its sources and, if not, correct it — a bounded verify/correct loop. Provider-free core (judge, corrector, and generator are injected functions); fail-safe (a broken judge/corrector never crashes answering or silently claims an answer is verified). AI SDK judge + corrector adapter included.

adapters.name: ai-verify
adapters.desc: Build a Judge and Corrector from AI SDK models (strict JSON-reply fact-check + a revise pass). Requires the `ai` peer dep.
